Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Bangladesh players make their way out to the middle followed by Kusal Perera and Danushka Gunathilaka. Mehidy Hasan will start with the ball.

One side of the ground is really small and one side is relatively big. The wicket is a tad on the slower side. The slower balls are gripping and the spinners are getting some purchase. It is not going to be an easy chase if Bangladesh bowl well but if Sri Lanka bat sensibly, they can chase this down. Join us for the chase in a while.

Mushfiqur Rahim was the star with the bat for Bangladesh. He came out when they were two down. First, he built a good stand with Tamim who also scored a half-ton and then a century stand with Mahmudullah. When the two were batting, 280 looked possible but both couldn’t kick on at the right time. Afif did play a decent cameo towards the end but not sure if this score is a good one.

The key for Sri Lanka was, they kept taking wickets at regular intervals, every time Bangladesh formed a partnership, Lanka managed to break it. Dhananjaya de Silva was the pick for them. They though will be a tad disappointed they could not capitalise after picking 4 for below 100 but overall, they have done a decent job.
So 257 is what Bangladesh end with! Not sure which side will be the happier of the two at the moment. Have to say, it is probably Sri Lanka who will head into the break as the happier one.
FOUR! Good end to the innings from Bangladesh! Full toss on off, Saifuddin whacks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. BANGLADESH END ON 257 FOR 6.
Afif Hossain makes room and Chameera follows him. Hossain works it down to long on for a single.
Low full toss on off, Saifuddin plays it to long on for a single.
Yorker on middle, Saifuddin digs it back to the bowler. Brilliant bowling from Chameera.
FOUR! Whipped away nicely by Saifuddin. Full on middle, Saifuddin whips it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Very full outside off, Saifuddin looks to drive but fails to get any bat on it.
Who will bowl the final over of the innings? Dushmantha Chameera it is.
FOUR! That is a very good cricket shot and good end to the over for Bangladesh! Full ball outside off, Hossain paddles it over short third man for a boundary.
Full ball outside off, Saifuddin moves inside his crease and then looks to heave it away but it goes of the inside edge, onto the pads and to the off side for a single.
Falls safely! Short ball outside off, Afif looks to play it over the off side but ends up slicing it towards deep point where it falls safely. A single.
2 runs.
FOUR! Well picked up by Afif Hossain! Fullish ball on the pads, Afif flicks it to the backward square leg region for a boundary.
WIDE! Too high says the umpire! Bouncer around middle, Afif ducks under it. Wided.
Short ball outside off, Saifuddin rises to the bounce and then plays it to deep cover for a single.
Very full on off, Hossain digs it out to cover. Excellent over from de Silva.
Flatter on middle, Saifuddin nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, Saifuddin punches it to deep cover for a single.
Low full toss outside off, Hossain drives but straight to the fielder at point.
Full ball on middle, Saifuddin flicks it to long on for a single.
Mohammad Saifuddin is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Dhananjaya de Silva is the man with the golden arm in this game and he has picked up his third wicket. Mahmudullah departs after playing a good innings but he needed to stay till the end. De Silva bowls a floated ball on middle, Mahmudullah looks to smack it to the leg side but misses and the ball hits the timber behind.

A dot to start the over but still a good one for Bangladesh. Could have been better had the long on fielder not made a top stop. On middle, it is whipped wide of long on. The fielder runs to his left and then dives, pushes it back in, saves two for his side.
FOUR! Finally a boundary for Bangladesh! This is short and wide outside off, it is cut through point for a boundary.

That is a superb effort! A lovely back of the hand slower ball on off. Afif is early in the shot as this one grips off the surface. It goes over mid off where the fielder runs back and then dives forward but does not hang on. He stop it though so only two.
This is brilliant bowling! Full and outside off, bowling to his field. It is hit through covers for one.
One more short one. Slower in length. Afif looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads, it rolls on the leg side one for one.
A good slower one, shorter slower ball. Hossain looks to pull but misses. Afif is struggling here.
Just the 5 from the 46th! Full and outside off, it is hit down to long off for one.
Dots are even better! A yorker outside off. Hossain fails to jam it out.
Another single! Singles won't bother Lanka. On middle, this is swept through mid-wicket for one.
Makes room and he is followed by de Silva. He pushes it through covers for one.
A yorker there on middle, it is jammed down to long on for one.
Direct hit and Afif would have been a goner! On middle, this is worked towards the leg side. They go for one. The keeper gets to the ball quickly and then has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Lankan's best bowler today, De Silva is back!
Just another single! Sri Lanka really bowling well in the death! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Brilliant! A yorker now on middle, it is worked down to long on for one.
Teally good! Varying his pace nicely. Now it is a seam up ball. Full and outside off. The batter is late in the drive.
Really well bowled! A slower one, it lands outside off and grips. Mahmudullah is beaten as he tries to push at it.

Two is the call and two is what they get! Fifty for Mahmudullah. Came in at a difficult time and has done well till now. He knows his job is only half done. A low full toss on off, it is stroked through covers for two.
WIDE! That is very wide outside off, left alone.
A dot to begin! A yorker outside off, Mahmudullah looks to jam it out but fails to put bat on ball.
Udana is back into the attack!
A single to end a top class over! On middle, it is worked down to long on for one.
Hossain is off the mark! On off, this is guided towards short third man for one.
Yet another dot! On off, it is played to covers.
Tosses it up on off, it is kept out.
Flatter and on middle, blocked.

OUT! TAKEN! Timely wicket for Bangladesh. Rahim was looking to step up the ante and he falls. Nevertheless a superb innings from him comes to an end. He deserved a ton but falls short of it. He tries to play the reverse sweep, hits it nicely but straight to point. Can Lanka now build on this and keep Bangladesh under 260?
Commentary.Howout: c Isuru Udana b Lakshan Sandakan

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, this is hit down to long on for one. A superb over for Bangladesh.
Outside off, this is cut through point for one.
Mahmudullah now sweeps this through square leg for one.
Rahim misses out! The full toss on middle, it is swept but off the inner half through square leg for only one. That was the shorter side, he would be disappointed.
FOUR! Up and over! Lovely shot. 6 from the first two balls. On off, Rahum makes room and lifts it over covers for a boundary.
Two! The paddle scoop is out. He plays it nice and fine towards fine leg for two.

Quicker and outside off, Rahim stays back and plays it through point for one more. 100 run stand up between the two. It has changed the tide in the hosts' favor. Can they help their side finish strongly?
Just the one. Mahmudullah 4 away from a half ton. Shorter and outside off. It is guided through point for one.
Rahim skips down the track and hits it through covers for one.
Really full and on off, it is jammed towards long for one.
Outside off yet again. Rahim guides it through covers for one.
Another dot! Outside off, this is played to covers.
Sandakan is back into the attack!
Just the one from the over. Exceptional from Hasaranga! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, kept out. 5 dots then.
Flatter and on off, it is pushed to covers.
Turn and bounce there! Bangladesh bowlers won't mind seeing this. It lands on off and the turns away. Mahmudullah looks to block but is beaten.
The googly, it lands outside off and turns back in. Mahmudullah guides it to point.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
Powerplay 3! Now five fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
A good slower one to end. It is pushed to mid off. Another tidy over.
Another sharp bumper. Mahmudullah lets it go over him.
Outside off, this is slapped through point for one more.
A good short one, gets big on the batter. Mahmudullah looks to pull but gets a top edge. It lands safe in the fine leg region for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, Rahim pushes it to mid on.
Outside off, Mahmudullah guides it to point. A dot to end a tidy over from Hasaranga.
On the pads yet again, it is nudged on the leg side for one more.
Bowled into the pads, it is flicked towerds square leg for one.
Very full and on middle, it is jammed back to the bowler.
Outside off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on middle, it is pulled towards deep square leg for one.
A single as this is worked on the leg side.
On off, it is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, this is guided through point for one.
On the pads, Mahmudullah looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side for one. Leg bye.
Short and wide outside off, this is cut through point. One taken.
Chameera is back on! 5-0-22-1 his figures.
Shorter and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Tossed up on middle, blocked.
And again, playing with the field. This is quicker and shorter. Rahim rocks back and pulls it over mid on who was just got up in the ring. Does not have the legs to go for a boundary. Two taken.
FOUR! Swept and done so brilliantly! Playing with the field is Rahim. They had a deep mid-wicket for him so he move across and then sweeps it through square leg.
Fuller and on off, it is driven through covers for one.
That spun back in sharply. Outside off and it comes back in. Mahmudullah looks to cut but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Hasaranga is on now!

Three runs in the end! Sloppy from Sri Lanka. On the pads, it is worked on the leg side. They take one. The throw is towards the bowler but no one is backing up. The fielder at deep mid-wicket runs to his right and stops it with his leg. Saves 2 for his side. End of another good over.
FOUR! Up and over! Floats it up a little too full on off, it is lifted over mid off for a boundary.
That could have been two! Shorter and outside off, it is slapped wide of sweeper cover for a couple.
Outside off, Mahmudullah pushes it through covers for one.
Outside off, this is guided to short third man.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Mahmudullah looks to sweep but misses. Wided.
Edgy and two more! Shorter and outside off, Mahmudullah slashes at it. It goes off the outside edge down towards third man for two.
Shorter and on the pads, it is worked down to fine leg for one. So 5 singles and a boundary from the over. Good stuff.

FOUR! Too straight and put away. It was actually really well played. Udana looks to go for a yorker on middle, he almost bowls a perfect one but Mahmudullah manages to jam it out through backward square leg for a boundary.
Nicely drive through covers but towards the man in the deep. Just the one.
Another run towards third man! This is on a length and around off, Mahmudullah waits for it and then plays it towards third man for one.
Rahim now waits for it and then guides it down to third man for one.
Bangladesh are happy to work it around and take the ones at the moment! On off, it is guided down to third man for one.

DRINKS! Quite even at the moment! Bangladesh have recovered well after they lost two quickly. Mahmudullah and Rahim are going along nicely but they need to bat at least till the 45th over. Bangladesh will probably be looking at something around 250. Lanka on the other hand, need to break this stand or it could take the game away from them. An interesting passage awaits.
Flatter and on off, it is guided to point.
On middle, it is worked through mid-wicket. The call is for two but they have to be happy with one.
Just the single from it. De Silva slows it up and lands it on middle. It is slog swept but towards deep square leg for one.
Mahmudullah is happy to work it around the corner and take one. It is also a no ball as De Silva has overstepped. Free Hit coming up.
Fifty run stand up between the two. Much-needed as Bangladesh were in trouble when Mahmudullah walked out. They need to keep going. On the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Rahim comes down the track but the length is shrotened. It is worked to mid-wicket.
Verti fine! The paddle sweep is out. Mahmudullah uses the pace and hits it over the keeper's head. Three runs.
A dot to end! Good length and on off, Rahim guides it to point.
On the pads, this is clipped on the leg side for one.
Fuller and outside off again, Rahim leans into it and strokes it through covers for one more.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Mahmudullah now looks to play it down to third man but the man at point dives to his left and stops it.
Starts off with a fuller ball on off, Rahim opens the face at the very end and plays it towards third man for one.
Udana is back on for his second spell.
Flatter and on off, Rahim clips it through mid-wicket for one. A good over for Bangladesh.
On off, blocked.

FOUR! Rahim brings his fifty up in style. 40th in ODIs. He skips down the track and gets to the pitch of it. Lifts it over mid off for a boundary. Picked his spot well. He needs to go on unlike his skipper, he has worked hard so far and needs to continue to do so.
Mahmudullah now eases it down to long on for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Two! Really good running! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket. In the gap for a couple.
Very full and on off, it is driven to covers.
Confusion but safe! Shorter and on off, Mahmudullah pushes it towards cover. He wants a run but is sent back.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Trademark Rahim. He is so good at this shot. It is the googly, he goes down on one knee and drags it over mid-wicket. No one there so a boundary.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Shorter and around off, this is guided to point.
WIDE AND A RUN! Down the leg side. Rahim looks to sweep but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and a run is taken.
4 dots to end the over then! On middle, it is played back to the bowler.
Another one which is tossed up nicely on off, blocked.
Flighted ball on off, defended.
Floats it up on off, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Two! Little bit of width and a little short. It is cut through point for two.
Gives it air and lands it outside off, it is hit through covers for one.
A dot to end a tidy over! On off, this is driven to covers.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up again, Mahmudullah looks to push at it but it goes off the outer half towards point.
On middle, blocked.
Tosses it up on off, this is played to covers.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for another run.
Floats it up on middle, defended.
Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Tossed up on middle, blocked.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
One more! On middle, it is hit down to long on for one.
SIX! That was much-needed. It should release a lot of pressure. Mahmudullah skips down the track and gets to the pitch of it. He hits it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Fires it on off, it is hit through covers for one.
On middle, this is pushed down to mid on for no runs.
Another one on middle, Mahmudullah nudges it around the corner for one more.
Very full and on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Edgy runs! This is tossed up outside off, it is the googly, Mahmudullah pushes at it. It goes off the outside edge down towers third man for two.
Slightly shorter and outside off, it is guided through point for two.
Flatter and outside off, this is guided to point.
On middle, this is clipped towards mid-wicket for one.
Rahim plays the paddle sweep, it is played nice and fine. Rahim wants to two but his partner is happy with one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
One more single! On middle, this is played with the turn down to long on for one.
On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Flatter and on off, it is kept out.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Good amount of turn there! This lands outside off and spins back in. Mahmudullah looks to defend but it beats the inside edge and hits the top of the pad.
No hat-trick. Short and outside off, it is slapped through covers for one.
The googly, it lands outside off and spins away. Left alone. Just the one from the over.
Really full and on off, Mahmudullah jams it out towards cover.
Very full and on off, it is blocked.
Shorter and on off, it is guided to point.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is played down to long on for one.

OUT! THREE REDS AND DE SILVA HAS TWO IN TWO! Bangladesh in trouble yet again. They have also lost both their reviews now. Not sure what Mithun tried doing there. First ball he faces, he tries to play a paddle sweep. It lands outside off and then turns back in. He misses and it hits the pad. An appeal and the finger is raised. Mithun reviews but replays show that he needs to take the long walk back. The bowler will be on a hat-trick in the next over.
Do Sri Lanka have another one? Mithun has been give out LBW but he reviews. Seems out.

OUT! THREE REDS AND TAMIM IS A GONER! Not sure why he reviewed that one. That looked out completely. Also, his attempt to put the bowler off his length by moving around in his crease has proved to be his downfall. De Silva just fires it full and on middle. Tamim looks to flick but misses. It hits his pad. An appeal and the finger is raised. After a chat, Tamim reviews but replays show that Bangladesh lose one. Timely wicket for Sri Lanka as the two just started to get going. Tamim does not last long after getting to a half to .
Review time! Tamim has been given out LBW but he reviews. This looks plumb.
On middle, it is flicked to mid-wicket.
Good rotation of strike. Rahim now works it through the leg side for one.
Angled into the middle pole, it is flicked toward square leg for one.
On middle, this is clipped on the leg side for one.
Another single to end! Outside off, this is guided to point.
Into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A single as this is guided through point.

Clever batting! Follows the boundary With a single as this is pushed down to long off. That is also fifty for Tamim. Excellent innings by the skipper. Started off cautiously but now getting into his own. They would want a big one from him here.
FOUR! Hammered! This is tossed up nicely but it is a little too full. Tamim punishes it through the off side for another boundary. Runs flowing now.
On off, this is played to the right of the bowler who dives and stops it.
SIX! The last ball spoils the over. Hasaranga gives it flight. Rahim goes down on one knee and then plays the slog sweep over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Tossed up on off, Rahim strokes it to covers.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long off for one.
On the pads, this is tucked around the corner for one.
Fuller and on off, this is driven through covers for one.
Outsidr off, left alone.
On middle, blocked.
SIX! All the way! First of the innings and Bangladesh have probably decided to target Sandakan. This is floated up on middle, it is lofted over the long on fence.
Outside off, Tamim guides it to point.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Probably the wrong end! On middle, this is pushed to mid off. Rahim is a little late to take off. The fielder at mid off though fires it at the bowler's end but misses.
Gives it air and lands it on middle, it is played back to the bowler.
Shorter and on the pads, skids through. Tamim mistimes his pull towards square leg for one.
Outside off, Rahim waits for it and then plays it very late, down to third man for two.
Sharp turn! On off and it spins back in. Rahim gets his bat down in time and blocks it.
A single to end and it is a good over for Bangladesh. On middle, it is played down to long on for one.
Outside off, left alone.
A single as this is pushed down to long off.
Tossed up on middle, it is played to mid on.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Short and on middle, Tamim rocks back and hammers it over mid-wicket.
This though is not what Bangladesh needed. A dot on the Free Hit. It is full and on off, Tamim hits it hard but to covers.
On middle, this is played down to long on for one. Sandakan has overstepped and a Free Hit is coming up. Just what Bangladesh needed.

Really good from Lanka so far! They have managed to keep it tight and also taken two wickets. They would want to continue the pressure and keep picking wickets at regular intervals. Bangladesh will want these two to bat for as long as possible if they are to get to a good score. Will we see a fight back or will Lanka continue to dominate?
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, it is pushed to covers.
A full toss, this is hit down to long on for one.
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Another one on middle, this one stays low. Tamim gets his bat down in time and pushes it back to the bowler.
On middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Shortish and on off, this is cut but to point.
This one is a bad ball but not put away! On the pads, it is worked down to fine leg for one.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Good length and on off, blocked. Really good bowling, giving nothing away.
Sligjtly fuller this time and on off, Rahim strokes it to covers.
Good length and on off, defended nicely.

NOT OUT! Tamim is in easily. On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket. Tamim takes off but is sent back. The fielder hits the stumps at the keeper's end. It is referred. Replays show that Tamim is fine.
Run out appeal is taken upstairs. Tamim seems relaxed though.
Rahim probably misses out. This is short and on middle, Rahim looks to pull but mistimes it down to long on for one.
Floats it up on off, it is pushed to covers.
That is a beauty! It has spun. It lands on middle and the turns away. Rahim goes back to a delivery he probably should have played ahead too. He is beaten.
Tossed up on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Beaten! Good start by Hasaranga! Outside off, Tamim slashes at it but misses.
Hasaranga is on now!
Two! Short and wide outside off, Rahim cuts it through point. The fielder at third man runs to his right, dives, stops the ball and then parries it to the man running to his left from covers. Two.
Fifty up for Bangladesh! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Slightly fuller and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A short one. Rushes onto Tamim. He mistimes his pull towards deep mid-wicket for one.
On off, blocked.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On the bounce! On the pads, Rahim plays the sweep. It goes off the top edge but lands short of square leg for one.
On middle, this is played with soft hands to square leg.
Angled into the pads, it is worked to square leg for one.
On off, it is pushed to covers.
Rahim is off the mark! On the pads, it is swept down to fine leg for one.
Chameera is back on.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks out to bat!
OUT! TAKEN! That is a huge wicket. The pressure of dot balls has gotten to Shakib.
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Danushka Gunathilaka

Commentary.Commentary: Another dot to end! On off, kept out.
Floats it up on off, Tamim pushes it to covers. Bangladesh have been quite watchful so far.
Quicker and on middle, Iqbal plays it back to the. bowler.
On middle, Tamim nudges it on the leg side.
Angled into the middle pole, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Shakib comes down the track and then works it down to long on for one.
Flatter and on middle, it is stroked to covers. A tidy start then from Danushka.
Just the one! Outside off, it is guided through point for one.
Gives it a lot of air again, it is driven straight. The bowler dives to his left and stops it.
Slows it up! On off, played back to the bowler again.
Slower and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Fuller and on off, this is played back to the bowler.
Time for Powerplay 2! 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over now. Also, Gunathilaka is on.
A dot to end. Bangladesh are 40 for 1 after the first 10. A sedate start by them. On off, this is hit to covers.
On middle, this is nudged towards square leg. Shakib wants one but is sent back.
One more single. On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side this time. Wided.
Shakib this time gets it past the man diving in the cover region and down to long off for one.
Fuller now on off, it is pushed to covers.
Fired into the pads, this is worked to square leg.
A dot to end but 10 from it. On off; it is pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Through the off side this time! This is probably the pressure releasing over. This is a half volley outside off. Tamim creams it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! This time Tamim latches onto the short one. It is angled into the body. He pulls it through mid-wicket and races away. Welcome boundary.
On middle, it is played back to the bowler.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
Just the single from the over! On middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Well fielded! The pressure continues to mount. Tossed it up on off, it is driven hard but the fielder at covers, dives and stops it.
This time he fails to stop the run as it is hit last him, down to long off for one.
Well fielded! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to the right of the bowler who dives and saves one.
Another dot. Tossed it up on off, it is played to covers.
Fires it in on middle, blocked.
De Silva is on now! First change!
A maiden! Really good from Udana! Length and on off, it is pushed to covers for one.
Fuller and on off, it is played back to the bowler.
Length and around off, no timing as it is pushed to covers.
This one stays a touch low! Shortish and outside off, Shakib slashes at it but misses.
On middle, Shakib hangs back and blocks it.
Tamim takes a few steps down the track and this is bowled short. It is slapped to the cover fielder.
Attacka the ribs of Tamim. This one is close to 150 KPH. Tamim nudges it on the leg side. A Lacey delivery to end a good over for Bangladesh.
Nicely played in the end! This is short, it hurries onto the batter. Tamim with a leg up, pulls it through mid-wicket for two:
Some extra bounce! Length and on off, it is guided to point.
Good running! Fuller and on off, Hasan pushes it to mid off and gets to the other end. Early call and hence, the run was completed with ease.
WIDE! This is bowled down the leg side. Wided.
Shot! No runs though. Length and on off, it is pushed to covers.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Another one on the pads and Shakib too is way too good to miss out! He works it really fine and to the fine leg fence.
Outside off, left alone.
Goea back to bowling it on off, blocked.
FOUR! Too easy! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side and it races away to the fence. Easy pickings for Tamim. He loves it there. This should release the pressure that was building.
On off, defended.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Beaten! Length and around off, this shapes away. Tamim goes fetching after it but gets beaten.
Through the gap this time but only two! Shorter and outside off, Shakib cuts it through point for a couple. A quiet over this one.
On off, kept out.
Fuller and on off, this is bowled at above 140 KPH. It is pushed to mid off.
Good length and on off, blocked.
That has been creamed but for no runs! Length and on off, it is hit on the up but to point.
On middle, this is worked to square leg.
Single to end then! Outside off, this is played down to third man for one.
Persists with that line outside off and keeps hitting the length again. Not played at.
Once again it is on a length, left alone:
Outside off and on a length. Left alone.
Quick run! Length and on off, this is pushed wide of mid off for two.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, Tamim slashes at it but misses.
No timing for Tamim again. Outside off, Tamim looks to drive but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.

FOUR! Creamed! That is some shot to get off the mark! It is full and around off, Shakib leans into it and caresses it through covers. Another over which ends with a boundary but it is a wicket taking one.
A little bit of swing there! Fuller and on middle, this is played to mid on.
Outside off, left alone.
Shakib walks at to bat pretty early!

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Sri Lanka strike early, just the start they would have wanted. That though is a loose stroke from Das. He will be very disappointed. It is slightly fuller and outside off, Das just plays at it way away from his body. Pretty lazily. It goes off the outside edge and first slip takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dhananjaya de Silva b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: Slightly fuller this time, Das strokes it to mid off.
Good length and on off, it is guided to point.
Dushmantha Chameera to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Put away! Tamim off the mark in style! Shorter and outside off, he slashes at it. Goes uppishly but wide of point for a boundary. Not a good end to the first over, 5 from it.
No timing again! Fuller and on middle, Iqbal pushes at it but mistimes it to mid on.
Right off the middle! Length and around off, this is guided to point.
Angled into the pads, this one holds a touch. Tamim pushes at it, it goes off the inner half to square leg.

Caught in two minds! Length and just around off, Tamim looks to defend but this one shapes away. He then tries to leave it but it hits the bottom and goes towards the slip cordon all along the ground.
WIDE! Bangladesh are underway courtesy an extra! Udana slips this one down the leg side. It is left alone.
Starts off well, on a length and outside off, little bit of movement away. Left alone.

It is now time for the action to begin! The Lankan players make their way out to the middle and are followed by the Bangladesh openers, Tamim Iqbal and Litton Das. There is a chat between the two batters and the umpires as it has gone a little hazy. A little bit of a delay, not sure about the exact reason. We are all set for the action to finally begin now. Isuru Udana to bowl now.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mohammad Mithun, Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Kusal Perera (WK/C), Danushka Gunathilaka, Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis, Dhananjaya de Silva, Dasun Shanaka, Ashen Bandara, Wanindu Hasaranga, Isuru Udana, Lakshan Sandakan, Dushmantha Chameera.
TOSS - Bangladesh won the toss and ELECTED TO BAT!

The two sides recently played a Test series which was won by the Lankans 1-0. Now, the hosts, would want to win this one, in familiar conditions and in a format where they arguably perform a lot better. Sri Lanka though have not had a good time in this format in recent times so they also would be eager for a win. It should be an exciting contest. Toss in a bit, stay tuned.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the first ODI between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. After all the concerns of the series going ahead due to a player testing positive for covid, the good news is, the series will go on and we will get some taste of ODI cricket.
